connector.name: Token Savior
connector.registryDescription: Structural codebase MCP server with persistent memory: navigate by symbol, recall across sessions.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package token-savior-recall. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mibayy account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: WORKSPACE_ROOTS
env.description: Comma-separated list of absolute paths to project roots to index.

env.name: TOKEN_SAVIOR_CLIENT
env.description: Optional client identifier (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'hermes') for usage attribution.

env.name: TOKEN_SAVIOR_PROFILE
env.description: Manifest size. 'optimized' (recommended) advertises the Pareto-optimal 15-tool set; 'auto' sizes it from your own usage; 'full' advertises every tool; 'compact-only' if you already run symbol navigation elsewhere.
